name: Safe Keeping Place 3
definition: Place where the securities are safe-kept, physically or notionally. This place can be, for example, a local custodian, a Central Securities Depository (CSD) or an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD).

LEI.name: LEI
LEI.definition: Legal entity identification as an alternate identification for a place of safekeeping.

SafekeepingPlaceFormatOrLEIRule.definition: SafekeepingPlaceFormat must be present or LEI must be present.
